notes.title: A Brand New Level Pack: "Aberrations"
notes.content:
We love players of Neon Rider and want to make sure you have an amazing experience with the game. We've heard that you appreciated the last level pack because it expanded the game and added exciting new features and challenges. 

Now we've gone farther. Today we've released a brand-new level pack, "Aberrations," and we think it's going to blow your mind. Here's what's in the update.
[list]
[*] 12 intense new levels
[*] wild new mechanics: gravity can now shift in any direction, allowing for topsy-turvy challenges that really extend your skills
[*] expands the overall play time and depth of play through intricate, flowing levels
[*] new color set options to improve colorblind accessibility
[*] a new achievement for completing "Aberrations" in under 17 minutes
[/list]
It's a whole new year, and now you have a whole new level pack to make it a little more fun. We hope you enjoy Neon Rider. If you do, please leave a review for us—it really helps!

Keep Flipping,
— The AG Crew

notes.title: Brand NEW Level Pack coming to Neon Rider Classic!
notes.content:
We're excited to share some sketches for our brand NEW Level Pack that is in the works for Neon Rider Classic. This will double the number of Steam only levels and give players a reason to come back and play again. 

If you want to see us continue to make new level packs, please leave us a review so we know you enjoy these updates! 

Thank you again for all your support and Happy Gaming!

notes.title: Sonny Legacy Collection Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the release of the [i]Sonny Legacy Collection[/i] on Steam! This collection brings together the iconic Sonny 1 & Sonny 2 RPG series, featuring quality of life updates, achievements and all the nostalgic elements fans know and love.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/2757720/Sonny_Legacy_Collection/

Whether you’re a longtime fan or new to the series, this collection offers hours of strategy, action, and unforgettable storytelling.

Join Sonny on his epic journey as he battles enemies, levels up, and uncovers the mysteries of his past.
Get ready to dive into the world of Sonny today — available now on Steam!

notes.title: Speed Devil - 16 All New Challenging Levels
notes.content:
You asked, We delivered! Here are 16 new levels to conquer that are only available in the Steam version. Take on the new Boost mechanic as you flip, spin and jump your way to a new High Score. These levels are longer and more challenging than the base game!  We've also added 1 achievement tied to these new levels.

If you enjoy Neon Rider; please let us know in the comments. Thanks!

Keep Flipping,
-The AG Crew
